chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 200: Li Huowang's Shadow-Puppet Body & the Aftermath of Carnage
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang’s body becomes a disconnected shadow puppet! A new Heart-Element power? After the siege, the town is a charnel house and a bewildered eunuch overseer navigates the brutal, laughing victors.
og_title: Chapter 200: The Shadow Puppet — A New Horror and a Brutal Aftermath
og_description: Li Huowang’s body becomes a phantom. In the ruined town, convict-soldiers feast and a eunuch seeks the wounded general. Horror and black humor collide.
twitter_title: The Shadow Puppet — Li Huowang's Body is Broken Again
twitter_description: A new horror. Li Huowang controls a phantom body while the victors joke about 'pork' in a town of corpses. The general is wounded, and a bureaucrat is walking to his doom.
